title: Preorder traversal
statementMd:
Return the values in preorder (node, left, right). The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `preorder([3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7])` returns `[3, 9, 20, 15, 7]`.
